notes.title: Layover Lovers released!
notes.content:
Greetings, moonlings!

Our past couple of years have been filled with slumps and silence but we're getting back into working on projects again.

It's taken a while but Layover Lovers is finally released on Steam! It's a short one as usual. We hope you'll like the story we have for it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2618830/Layover_Lovers/

Additionally, we are offering a few treats to celebrate this occasion!

Carpe Diem: Reboot is currently at its deepest discount for a week (until the 23rd).

https://store.steampowered.com/app/686760/Carpe_Diem_Reboot/

Without Romance now has an added Steam achievement.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1409610/Without_Romance/

And while we're at it, we might as well add a link to our first-ever project, Carpe Diem.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/423880/Carpe_Diem/

Don't worry about the messy capsules.

[h2]Extra Moonlit Works[/h2]

In case you missed, we also have some projects outside of Steam.

The first 2 parts to our video miniseries [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLOuw4fW6xvAWIhgjbF1xqnW5p5s7Vc31l]Third Wheel[/url] are out on Youtube! The next parts are in the works.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLOuw4fW6xvAWIhgjbF1xqnW5p5s7Vc31l][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33020476/b57434a77fd12e980a9956290dd0774d4af042ec.png[/img][/url]

Our first original song, Endings, was released on [url=https://youtu.be/_blMhIwwVOY]Youtube[/url] and [url=https://open.spotify.com/track/7zt5ylR21OdV5EfXbY8kf2]Spotify[/url]! We enjoyed experimenting and testing out the process of making this and we are keen on making more originals in the future.

[url=https://youtu.be/_blMhIwwVOY][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33020476/5aedd7ab9d278befcfa1202cfbdfcfba8628ea4e.png[/img][/url]

To close it off, here's a glance into some of our work-in-progresses.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33020476/c5af280c86cf20d20e6bbb39237930f9b41af05b.png[/img][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33020476/3f8ac005e529472cad7a1eda695283c3b4e7ae3c.png[/img][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33020476/2cae3015605eff9d7bbd851cfa5b164e3f0caa41.png[/img][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33020476/1070832b87a9106c6db260791508264822106719.png[/img]

What kind of projects could they be? Join our [url=https://discord.gg/moonlitworks]Discord[/url] or follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/moonlitworks]Twitter[/url] to stay up-to-date!

Til next time!

notes.title: Without Romance released!
notes.content:
Hello! I hope you're doing well.

If you didn't know, Moonlit Works participated in the Summer Novel Festival 2020 and our entry, Without Romance, is now out on Steam. I hope you like it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1409610/Without_Romance/



[h1]Other Moonlit updates[/h1]

Another short visual novel is coming out soon! Layover Lovers. A terminal love story.
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33020476/9b7b514a926e1fc9d53a8a7de8c0914141b13038.png[/img]

Stay tuned for updates on our current project as well. A rhythm visual novel titled Bubblegum Beat.
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33020476/fc3aeca21adfa7f6ff75909dc5b520ea7569d2ae.png[/img]

For more updates, follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/moonlitworks]Twitter[/url] or join us on [url=https://discord.gg/moonlitworks]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: New project in the works, Whence We Love!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33020476/483b781205f735e46f5401402753fb2bbf4328d4.png[/img]

Just a quick announcement!

It's been over a year since Reboot was released and we have been quiet for a while. We've been playing around with a few ideas and we've finally decided on what to work on next!

Our current project is a visual novel titled [b]Whence We Love[/b]. The characters in the image above are the three main girls of the story. From left to right: Rae, Daisy, and Ella.

If you want to support the development and follow our progress with it, you can [url=https://www.patreon.com/moonlitworks]become a patron on our Patreon page[/url]! We will post WIPs there as well as a general update with a bonus artwork every month.



In case you have not seen Carpe Diem: Reboot yet, check out its store page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/686760/Carpe_Diem_Reboot/
